title: Feature table
doc: Indexes the files, detects the features of each, aligns them and writes the table as CSV: the chain of `mzlab-cli features` as one step.

source.title: Vendor files or mzML, one series

title: Centroid the spectra
doc: Reduces every profile scan of an mzML to one point per peak with the centroider of the archive; centroid scans, chromatograms and a file with no profile scan are left as they are.

mzml.title: mzML with one point per peak

fwhm.title: Peak width
fwhm.description: FWHM of a peak; left out, it is measured on the isolated peaks of the file

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: A peak is kept when it stands this many sigma over the background (Poisson Z for counts); left out, the value of the mode of the file

title: MS2 spectra from mzML
doc: Reads the MS2 scans of data-dependent runs and writes them as spectra with precursor m/z and intensity, charge, RT and scan number; given a feature table it keeps the scans of its features and names each spectrum with the feature id.

features.title: Feature table: keep the scans of its features

min_intensity.title: Peak threshold
min_intensity.description: Peaks below this intensity are dropped; a scan left with no peak is dropped

max_isolation.title: Largest isolation window
max_isolation.description: Scans whose isolation window is wider are dropped; off when absent, and a scan that does not say its window is kept

tol_da.title: Precursor tolerance
tol_da.description: With a feature table: largest distance between the precursor and the m/z of the feature

rt_tol.title: RT tolerance
rt_tol.description: With a feature table: largest distance between the scan and the RT of the feature

dia_pseudo.title: DIA pseudo spectra
dia_pseudo.description: For data-independent runs (SWATH, MSE): one pseudo MS2 spectrum per feature of the table, made of the fragments whose trace follows that of the precursor; needs the feature table, and the DDA scans are not written

dia_min_corr.title: Fragment correlation
dia_min_corr.description: With `dia_pseudo`: least Pearson correlation between the trace of a fragment and that of the precursor

dia_min_points.title: Cycles per peak
dia_min_points.description: With `dia_pseudo`: fewest cycles of the RT range of a feature; a feature with fewer has no spectrum

dia_frag_ppm.title: Fragment tolerance
dia_frag_ppm.description: With `dia_pseudo`: window around an m/z to follow its trace

title: MSn fragmentation graph
doc: Merges the MSn spectra of an infusion into one graph of ions and neutral losses, with the sub-formulas of the fragments when the ion of the root is given. It proposes candidates; it does not identify.

source.title: Vendor file or mzML of an MSn infusion

molecules.title: Molecules list (CSV) for the name of the molecule

formula.title: Ion of the root
formula.description: C13H25N4O3S+, C13H24N4O3S+H or "C13H24N4O3S [M+H]+"; empty = masses only, no sub-formulas
formula.x-tip: Formula of the root ion, e.g. C13H24N4O3S+H; leave empty for masses only.

molecule.title: Name of the molecule
molecule.description: Name, synonym, id or formula looked up in the molecules list of the port `molecules`; it gives the formula (and the SMILES) of the root with `adduct`. `formula` wins when both are given
molecule.x-tip: Name, synonym, id or formula to look up in the molecules list.

adduct.title: Adduct of the root
adduct.description: Adduct written after the formula of `molecule`, e.g. [M+H]+ or [M-H]-
adduct.x-tip: Adduct of the root ion, e.g. [M+H]+ or [M-H]-.

smiles.title: Structure (SMILES)
smiles.description: Written back in the graph; it does not change the numbers
smiles.x-tip: SMILES of the molecule, stored in the graph for the drawings.

molfile.title: Structure (molfile)
molfile.description: The 2D structure as a molfile, written back in the graph for the drawings; it does not change the numbers
molfile.x-tip: 2D structure as a molfile, stored in the graph for the drawings.

ppm_formula.title: Sub-formula window
ppm_formula.description: A sub-formula is a candidate of a fragment within this distance of its m/z
ppm_formula.x-tip: Maximum distance in ppm between a fragment m/z and a candidate sub-formula.

mz_basso.title: Low m/z limit
mz_basso.description: Below this m/z the window may widen to the low-mass window
mz_basso.x-tip: Below this m/z the wider low-mass window may apply.

ppm_basso.title: Low-mass window
ppm_basso.description: The wider window, for a candidate with enough evidences
ppm_basso.x-tip: Wider ppm window used below the low m/z limit when enough evidences support the candidate.

prove_min.title: Evidences for the wider window
prove_min.x-tip: Number of evidences a candidate needs to use the wider window.

attivazione.title: Activation
attivazione.description: Only the spectra of this activation (cid, hcd, ...); empty = all
attivazione.x-tip: Keep only spectra of this activation (cid, hcd, ...); empty keeps all.

isotopi.title: Keep M+1 peaks
isotopi.description: The M+1 peaks of the fragments become nodes with their monoisotopic peak
isotopi.x-tip: Turn the M+1 peaks of fragments into nodes linked to their monoisotopic peak.

strutture_nodo.title: Node for the structure cleavages
strutture_nodo.description: Node nK of the graph: adds the key `strutture`, the bonds of the structure whose cleavage gives its m/z (needs the structure); `tutti` = the key `strutture_tutti` for every node of level 2 or more; empty = none
strutture_nodo.x-tip: Node (nK) whose m/z is explained by structure cleavages; tutti for all nodes of level 2 or more.

ppm_struttura.title: Cleavage window
ppm_struttura.description: Distance of a cleaved piece from the m/z of the node
ppm_struttura.x-tip: Maximum distance in ppm between a cleaved piece and the m/z of the node.

interpreta.title: Interpret the losses
interpreta.description: Adds the key `interpretazione`: for each arc the neutral loss (name, formula, exact mass, ppm, reason, confidence) and the activations that saw it
interpreta.x-tip: Add to each arc the neutral loss, its mass error and the activations that saw it.

ppm_perdita.title: Loss window
ppm_perdita.description: Window of the loss match by mass, ppm of the precursor m/z
ppm_perdita.x-tip: Maximum distance in ppm, relative to the precursor m/z, for matching a loss by mass.

regole.title: Apply the fragmentation rules
regole.description: Adds the key `regole`: the rules of the table `fragrules/1` that the formulas alone decide (which rule explains the loss of an arc, even-electron check, trap cut-off, composite and stepped losses)
regole.x-tip: Add the rule that explains each loss, the even-electron check and the trap cut-off.

cutoff_q.title: Trap cut-off q
cutoff_q.description: Fragments below q/0.908 of the precursor m/z are not observable in a trap CID
cutoff_q.x-tip: Fragments below q/0.908 of the precursor m/z are treated as not observable.

toll_perdita_mda.title: Rule tolerance
toll_perdita_mda.description: Tolerance of a loss against the mass of a rule
toll_perdita_mda.x-tip: Maximum distance in mDa between a loss and the mass of a rule.

scelte.title: Chosen formulas
scelte.description: MZ=ION pairs separated by commas: the formula chosen for the node at that m/z
scelte.x-tip: Pairs MZ=ION separated by commas, fixing the formula of the node at that m/z.

rotture.title: Break the bonds of the structure
rotture.description: Adds the key `rotture`: the sets of atoms of the structure (one or two bonds cut, a few hydrogens moved) that give the m/z of each node, the arcs they explain and the share of each spectrum's intensity explained (needs the structure; window `ppm_struttura`)
rotture.x-tip: Add the atom sets of the structure, with bonds cut, that give the m/z of each node.

h_max.title: Hydrogens moved
h_max.description: Hydrogens moved at most beyond the plain cleavage, for the bond breaks
h_max.x-tip: Maximum number of hydrogens moved beyond the plain cleavage.

max_legami.title: Bonds cut
max_legami.description: Bonds cut at most for one piece, 1 or 2
max_legami.x-tip: Maximum number of bonds cut for one piece, 1 or 2.

title: MSn tree as a library
doc: Writes the spectra of the fragmentation graph as an MSP or MassBank library, one record per spectrum of the tree, with the proposed formula and the neutral loss of each explained peak. The formulas are candidates of the graph, not identifications.

library.title: Spectra of the tree (MSP or MassBank)

format.title: Format
format.description: MSP, or MassBank records (MS_TYPE MS2, MS3, ... and the path of precursors in the comment)

levels.title: MS levels
levels.description: all: one record per spectrum of the tree, MS2 and deeper; ms2: only the spectra of the first fragmentation

clean.title: Explained peaks only
clean.description: Keep only the peaks a node of the graph explains

annotate.title: Annotate peaks
annotate.description: Write the sub-formula of each explained peak and the neutral loss from its precursor (MSP: quoted note; MassBank: PK$ANNOTATION and a COMMENT)

id.title: Record name
id.description: Name of the records; empty = the formula of the ion of the root, or MSN

title: MSn graph as a table
doc: Writes the fragmentation graph as CSV: its ions with the proposed sub-formulas, its modifications (neutral losses between ions) or its peaks. The formulas are candidates of the graph, not identifications.

view.title: Table
view.description: modifications: one row per neutral loss between two ions of the tree (mass, formula, ppm, measures); nodes: one row per ion with its proposed sub-formula; peaks: one row per peak of every spectrum with its node

clean.title: Explained peaks only
clean.description: peaks table only: keep the peaks a node of the graph explains

title: MSn graph as a figure
doc: Draws the fragmentation graph as an SVG, a stand-alone HTML or a PNG: ions with m/z, relative intensity, MS levels and the proposed formulas, arrows for the neutral losses. The formulas are candidates of the graph, not identifications.

figure.title: Figure of the graph (SVG, HTML or PNG)

format.title: Format
format.description: svg: the static figure, colours written in the file; html: one file with no external resource, two views, data table and downloads; png: the SVG rasterised (only in a build with the cargo feature `png`)

view.title: View
view.description: tree: columns by MS level; radial: the precursor in the centre, one ring per step of the best path (the HTML has both and opens on this one)

title: Compare algorithms
doc: Runs the wrapped step once per variant on the same inputs and measures how the outputs differ; it does not say which variant is right.

labels.title: Labels of the variants, comma separated, in the order of the inputs

title: Dig the unit-resolution series
doc: Scores the products a parent can form in a series at unit resolution: peaks checked on their XIC, persistence, growth, blanks, chance. It proposes candidates; it does not identify.

table.title: Aligned feature table of the series, made by this plan

samples.title: Roles and times of the files

index.title: Scan index of each file of the series, in the order of the table

dig.title: Candidates with criteria, score and label (the JSON of the Dig)

title: Peaks of the UV trace
doc: Integrates the peaks of the UV/PDA trace of each file at one wavelength: apex, edges, width, height and area. With broad bands on it also finds the bands that the narrow peak finder loses. It lists peaks; it does not identify.

source.title: mzML files with a UV/PDA matrix

peaks.title: Peaks of the UV trace, one row each (CSV)

wavelength_nm.title: Wavelength
wavelength_nm.description: The trace is the matrix at this wavelength; the nearest column when none is inside the band

band_nm.title: Bandwidth
band_nm.description: The columns within half of this around the wavelength are averaged

broad.title: Broad bands
broad.description: Also look for bands too wide for the narrow peak finder

broad_min_s.title: Narrowest band
broad_min_s.description: Smallest full width at half maximum of a band

broad_max_s.title: Widest band
broad_max_s.description: Largest full width at half maximum of a band

broad_snr.title: Min. S/N of a band
broad_snr.description: Smallest height of a band over its bridge, in noise units

title: Calibrate
doc: Applies imported calibration curves (signal = slope x concentration + intercept) to the signal of the matched rows of the table; concentrations outside the linear range or below zero are flagged. The line is not fitted here.

curves.title: Calibration curves imported as CSV: name, mz, rt, slope, intercept, unit, range_min, range_max, dilution

samples.title: Roles of the files (campioni/1 or campioni/2)

concentrations.title: Concentration of each compound in each sample as CSV

mz_tol.title: m/z tolerance to match a curve to a row

rt_tol.title: RT tolerance to match a curve to a row

signal.title: Signal the curve was made with

kinds.title: Sample types to quantify, comma separated

title: Mass accuracy
doc: Measures the mass error of each file on ions that are known to be there (the lab background list, internal standards and standards of the user) and reports offset, spread, standards and warnings; with a model it also writes a copy of the feature table with its m/z corrected. Numbers only, no verdict.

table.title: Feature table (.mzfeat) whose m/z is corrected when a model is chosen

samples.title: Roles of the files; the files marked as internal standard files are checked for their standards

references.title: CSV of reference ions: name, ion (formula with its charge or adduct, or m/z), optional RT window, role (reference, istd or standard)

table.title: Feature table with the m/z corrected (only with a model)

search_ppm.title: Search window around each reference ion

min_intensity.title: Lowest peak intensity taken for a reference

min_refs.title: References a file needs to be assessed

warn_offset_ppm.title: Offset above which the file is flagged

warn_spread_ppm.title: Spread above which the file is flagged

warn_is_rt_min.title: RT shift limit of internal standards

warn_is_area_rsd.title: Area spread limit of internal standards

title: Check run order
doc: Reads the sample table and reports, for each batch, the number of files of each role, the largest gap between two QC injections, the blanks and the distinct standard levels, with a warning for a gap above the limit, a batch without QC or blank, too few standard levels, and a missing or repeated injection order. It reports facts, never a verdict.

samples.title: Sample table: role, injection order, batch (campioni/2 or /3)

design.title: Batches of the files; without it the batch of the sample table, else one batch

runorder.title: Counts and warnings of the injection sequence (runorder/1)

qc_every_max.title: Largest gap between QC injections
qc_every_max.description: A gap of more injections between two QC files of the same batch is reported; the gap is the difference of their injection positions
qc_every_max.x-tip: Report two QC files that are further apart than this.

std_levels_min.title: Standard levels per batch
std_levels_min.description: A batch whose standards and calibration files have fewer distinct concentrations is reported; 0 turns the check off
std_levels_min.x-tip: Report a batch with fewer distinct standard concentrations.

blank_per_batch.title: Blank in every batch
blank_per_batch.description: Report a batch without a blank file
blank_per_batch.x-tip: Report a batch with no blank.

title: Methods text
doc: Writes the methods of a run in English from its run record: every step with its version, algorithm and parameters, and the version of mzLab. It states what was set, never a result.

style.title: Layout
style.description: paragraph: one English paragraph per step; list: one bullet per step with every parameter

title: Find spectra in a library
doc: Writes the entries of the library you declare that have a given name, formula, InChIKey, accession or precursor m/z, with their peaks untouched, so that the next steps can use them as queries. The library is always the one you supply: nothing is built in and nothing is searched online.

spectra.title: The library entries found, as MGF

by.title: Look up by
by.description: The field of the library entries that value is compared with; precursor_mz takes a number and the window ppm

value.title: Value
value.description: The text to find (for precursor_mz, the m/z); required

exact.title: Whole name
exact.description: By name: the name must be the whole value, not only contain it (any case); the other fields are always compared whole

ppm.title: Precursor window
ppm.description: By precursor_mz: the entries whose precursor is this close to the value

top_n.title: Entries kept
top_n.description: The first entries in the order of the library; the rest are not written

title: Compare the MS2 of the table rows
doc: Takes the MS2 spectrum of every row of the aligned table, as the MGF export does, and scores it against a spectral library like spectra.match: the candidates of each row carry the score, the shared peaks, the decoy q-value and the name. A candidate is never an identity: the level is decided by annot.level.

samples.title: Roles and times of the files

index.title: Scan index of each file, in the order of the table

hits.title: Library candidates per row (query = id of the row)

tol_da.title: Fragment tolerance
tol_da.description: Fragment matching between spectra, the GNPS convention
tol_da.x-tip: Fragment window in Da; 0 follows the query: 0.02 Da, or 0.5 Da for a unit-resolution file.

tol_ppm.title: Fragment tolerance (ppm)
tol_ppm.description: Above 0 it replaces tol_da: a peak pairs within this many ppm of its own m/z (high-resolution spectra); the analogue search uses it too

precursor_ppm.title: Precursor tolerance
precursor_ppm.description: Library precursor against the precursor of the feature

precursor_da.title: Precursor window (low resolution)
precursor_da.description: Above 0 the precursor window is this many Da either side instead of precursor_ppm, for unit-resolution data (use a fragment tolerance of 0.3 to 0.5 Da); 0 keeps the ppm window
precursor_da.x-tip: Precursor window in Da for unit-resolution data; 0 keeps the ppm window, or 0.7 Da for a unit-resolution file.

name_contains.title: Library name contains
name_contains.description: Only library entries whose name contains this text (any case) are candidates; empty keeps all. The spectra still decide the score

rt_tol.title: RT tolerance
rt_tol.description: Above 0, a library entry whose retention time differs from the RT of the query spectrum by more than this is not a candidate; entries or queries without a retention time are kept. The candidate carries rt_delta_min (query minus library) when both are known; 0 switches the filter off. Not used by the tree algorithm

adduct_contains.title: Library adduct contains
adduct_contains.description: Only library entries whose adduct (for example [M+H]+) contains this text (any case) are candidates; empty keeps all. Not used by the tree algorithm

instrument_contains.title: Library instrument contains
instrument_contains.description: Only library entries whose instrument or instrument type contains this text (any case) are candidates, for example Orbitrap or QTOF; empty keeps all. Not used by the tree algorithm

ce_contains.title: Library collision energy contains
ce_contains.description: Only library entries whose collision energy text contains this text (any case) are candidates, for example 30 or HCD; empty keeps all. Not used by the tree algorithm

decoys.title: Decoys
decoys.description: spectrum: a decoy spectrum (random fragments, same intensities) is searched beside every library entry and each best hit carries decoy_q, the q-value of the batch; it is a lower bound of the true error rate (isomers and analogues are not random errors). Works with the entropy, cosine and modified cosine scores (not tree; the q-value counts the candidates inside the precursor window; an .mzlib is read back to spectra and rebuilt with the decoys); none leaves the hits as they are

matched_peaks.title: Matched peaks
matched_peaks.description: On: every candidate also lists matched_peaks, the pairs of peaks behind its score (m/z and relative intensity of the query and of the library spectrum, and whether the precursor shift was needed), so the match can be checked peak by peak; the scores do not change. Not used by the tree algorithm

score_terms.title: Score terms
score_terms.description: On: every candidate also carries score_terms, its score as a weighted sum of named terms (the contribution of each matched pair, the rest in one term) and the key of its formula in the Theory; the scores themselves do not change

ms2_spectrum.title: Spectrum of a row
ms2_spectrum.description: best: the scan with the highest TIC of the file that has the best MS2 of the row; consensus: all the fitting scans of the row, merged across the files where it has a peak

ms2_background.title: Take out the blank background
ms2_background.description: On: the MS2 peaks that recur in the blank files are taken out of every row, never the precursor; without a blank file nothing is taken out

algorithms.title: Spectral entropy
algorithms.doc: Entropy similarity of the merged spectrum after the cleaning of ms_entropy (entropy_from_pairs in crates/mzlab-lib/src/scores.rs); the search of ms2_engine/matcher.rs.

references.note: entropy similarity and its intensity weighting

min_score.title: Minimum score
min_score.description: A hit below this entropy similarity is dropped

min_shared.title: Minimum shared ions
min_shared.description: Matched ions between query and library spectrum; two peaks can score high on a sparse spectrum

algorithms.title: Cosine
algorithms.doc: One-to-one peak pairs within the tolerance, the highest intensity product first (cosine_from_pairs in crates/mzlab-lib/src/scores.rs); the review reads it with the GNPS preparation (gnps_cosine).

algorithms.title: Modified cosine
algorithms.doc: Peaks may also pair at the precursor difference, for analogues that differ by one modification (modified_cosine in crates/mzlab-lib/src/scores.rs).

references.note: modified cosine: peaks matched directly or shifted by the precursor mass difference

applicability.note: Analogues and transformation products of a known parent

analog_window_da.title: Analogue window
analog_window_da.description: Library precursors within this distance of the feature are candidate analogues

analog_prefilter.title: Candidates scored
analog_prefilter.description: Candidates that pass the prefilter and are scored with the modified cosine

analog_min_shift_da.title: Smallest shift
analog_min_shift_da.description: A smaller precursor difference is the same ion, not an analogue

exact_ppm.title: Exact match
exact_ppm.description: A precursor difference within this is an exact match, not an analogue

delta_formula_mda.title: Delta formula
delta_formula_mda.description: Free search of a CHNOPS formula for the precursor difference
